facts.fact: The Interior Minister says Law 18-07 of 10 June 2018 on personal data processing governs and sanctions illegal use of the NIN.
The Interior Minister says infractions will be sanctioned in coordination with the Autorite Nationale de Protection des Donnees a Caractere Personnel.
